claim_or_record: Original paper Table 1 lists HAM10000 as CC BY-NC 4.0 with 10,015 images.
evidence_examined: PMC article Table 1 inspected directly; exact HAM10000 row says CC BY-NC 4.0 and 10,015.
review_finding: Directly supported at dataset-table scope.
limitations: Does not establish local byte identity or per-image contributor rights.

claim_or_record: Article-level notice applies CC BY 4.0 to article content, subject to third-party credit lines.
evidence_examined: Original paper Rights and permissions notice inspected.
review_finding: The report keeps article license separate from the image collection.
limitations: Does not blanket-license all underlying photographs or dataset files.

claim_or_record: The paper CC0 waiver covers metadata files made available in the article, not automatically the local dataset CSV.
evidence_examined: Original paper notice states CC0 waiver applies to metadata files made available in this article.
review_finding: The local HAM10000_metadata.csv is not identified as one of those files.
limitations: Exact identity/scope for the local CSV remains unconfirmed.

claim_or_record: Dataverse v4.0 terms are in data.dvcore:termsOfUse; heading, value length and SHA-256 match the preserved evidence.
evidence_examined: Fresh API response status=OK, schema version 4.0, date 2018-06-04; exact field and full value compared to JSON and hash recomputed.
review_finding: 15,662 characters; SHA-256 15d4d8a8ada43a901459bc31feed59238d10e39b2e2814e3284e44b25734132a; no data.license key.
limitations: Versioned terms do not prove local files were obtained from this release.

claim_or_record: The 9,310 local split IDs match the 10,015-row local HAM metadata IDs.
evidence_examined: Recomputed set join from exploratory_split.csv to data/raw/HAM10000_metadata.csv.
review_finding: 9,310 unique split IDs; all are present in 10,015 unique local metadata IDs.
limitations: Identifier match is not byte identity or rights verification.

claim_or_record: Local image byte identity to Dataverse v4.0 is not established.
evidence_examined: Reviewed source-rights evidence, local metadata join, versioned API evidence, and file inventories.
review_finding: No official package checksum comparison or verified package receipt is recorded.
limitations: This validates the stated limitation, not absence of any outside evidence.

claim_or_record: Per-image/source-level rights are not verified for all 9,310 local images.
evidence_examined: Inspected local source manifest and split; no per-image contributor-license field/map is present in the cited rights audit.
review_finding: The paper describes source collections; the local mapping needed to verify each image is missing.
limitations: No claim that all local images have been individually rights-cleared.

claim_or_record: Dataverse fileRequestAccess=false is an access-request setting, not a license or proof of account policy.
evidence_examined: Re-fetched API field and compared to preserved JSON.
review_finding: The audit labels the field as access-request information and does not infer a license from it.
limitations: No account requirement conclusion is established by this field.

claim_or_record: Official Challenge page links aggregate CC-BY-NC to CC BY-NC 4.0 and requires citation DOI 10.34970/2020-ds01.
evidence_examined: Official Challenge 2020 page read in browser; link target and citation inspected.
review_finding: Page states 33,126 training records, metadata v2, aggregate CC-BY-NC, exact license link and citation.
limitations: Aggregate term does not resolve individual image terms or local file identity.

claim_or_record: ISIC Terms say contributors select CC0, BY, or BY-NC per image; image use is under applicable contributor license.
evidence_examined: Official Terms of Use inspected, including Contributions and License in Images sections.
review_finding: The report describes individual contributor terms separately from Challenge aggregate terms.
limitations: Terms do not resolve interaction for the planned use or specify a version for the API codes.

claim_or_record: ISIC Site Database and annotations are separately scoped under CC0, not treated as image licenses.
evidence_examined: Official Terms sections on Site Database, License in Images, and License in Annotations inspected.
review_finding: The audit does not generalize CC0 to underlying images.
limitations: This review makes no broader interpretation of database rights.

claim_or_record: All 79 API ID/license/attribution records match the local acquisition register.
evidence_examined: Fresh HTTP 200 GET for every URL; compared JSON values with 79 revalidation rows and acquired_source_attribution_v1.csv.
review_finding: 79/79 match; all 79 local image paths exist and local SHA-256 matches stored source-attribution value.
limitations: API record correspondence and local register hash do not prove fixed Challenge ZIP byte identity.

claim_or_record: The local 79-record subset contains 41 CC-BY and 38 CC-BY-NC records.
evidence_examined: Recomputed counts from fresh API responses for all 79 IDs.
review_finding: Current API counts are 41 CC-BY and 38 CC-BY-NC.
limitations: The codes do not state a version number.

claim_or_record: Individual API codes do not state license versions; per-image codes are not asserted to override aggregate Challenge terms.
evidence_examined: Fresh API object fields and official Terms/data page inspected.
review_finding: The API returns copyright_license codes only; report explicitly leaves terms interaction to researcher review.
limitations: Exact individual license versions and legal interaction remain unresolved.

claim_or_record: Local byte identity to the fixed Challenge JPEG ZIP remains unverified.
evidence_examined: Official Challenge page link identifies fixed ZIP; local acquisition register and pilot documentation reviewed.
review_finding: Audit documents API/S3 records and no fixed-ZIP byte comparison.
limitations: Absence of comparison in reviewed records does not establish historical nonexistence of outside proof.

claim_or_record: The exploratory split contains 845 Fanconic rows, all with blank image/patient/lesion IDs and source/folder label malignant.
evidence_examined: Recomputed exploratory split counts and fields.
review_finding: 845 rows; all three IDs blank; original_label malignant.
limitations: These local labels/partition fields do not verify clinical provenance or rights.

claim_or_record: Fanconic origin and rights remain UNVERIFIED_ORIGIN_PENDING; no permission is established.
evidence_examined: Inspected split, source manifest, provenance report, recovery documentation and rights audit.
review_finding: No authoritative acquisition receipt, verified remote checksums, image IDs, or contributor-license mapping was found in the reviewed local records.
limitations: A public Kaggle listing or metadata lead does not establish identity or permission.

claim_or_record: The possible Kaggle v4 match is an investigative lead only, not provenance or licensing proof.
evidence_examined: Local recovery document records a metadata-only query/path-size comparison; no raw response or remote content hashes were re-fetched in this review.
review_finding: Audit consistently labels it a lead and maintains unresolved status.
limitations: The rights audit evidence-register row links the versioned listing rather than the exact historical query endpoint.

claim_or_record: The precise evidence needed to resolve Fanconic origin and rights is identified.
evidence_examined: Inspected Fanconic provenance investigation and remaining-questions register.
review_finding: Required package/acquisition identity, checksums, image-to-source mapping, terms, and researcher review are listed.
limitations: None of these requirements are currently satisfied by the audit.

claim_or_record: CC BY-NC 4.0 summary states NonCommercial definition and attribution/modification conditions only where the license applies.
evidence_examined: Creative Commons CC BY-NC 4.0 legal code and preserved Dataverse terms field inspected.
review_finding: The audit qualifies applicability and does not infer license coverage from the legal text alone.
limitations: No legal advice or use-specific conclusion.

claim_or_record: The audit makes no categorical conclusion about model weights, predictions, hosted demos, or derived outputs.
evidence_examined: Reviewed research report, comparison and unresolved questions.
review_finding: These uses are expressly left for researcher/legal review.
limitations: Specific uses remain undecided.

claim_or_record: Protected-file inventories and current disk state have no missing, added, or changed protected files.
evidence_examined: Independently compared before/after manifests and SHA-256-hashed all current files in the manifest scope.
review_finding: 38,906 files / 9,856,101,469 bytes; exact path, size, and hash agreement.
limitations: Review output directory was excluded from protected scope as a new audit deliverable.

claim_or_record: Frozen split, preprocessing config, approval checklist, and existing best checkpoint retain their protected SHA-256 values.
evidence_examined: Current disk SHA-256 compared with both protected manifests and recorded values.
review_finding: All four critical hashes match.
limitations: No inference is made beyond file integrity.

claim_or_record: Approval checklist remains NOT_APPROVED and researcher decision fields remain blank.
evidence_examined: Read current approval_checklist_v1.json and all rows/decision fields of template.
review_finding: Status NOT_APPROVED; all researcher/review/decision fields blank.
limitations: No dataset approval or training authorization granted.

claim_or_record: No training/evaluation was performed as part of this independent review; historical audit assertion cannot be fully proved from static files.
evidence_examined: Review tool actions were read-only plus HTTP GET/hash operations; protected files did not change.
local_evidence_reference: Current review execution; protected before/after manifests
review_finding: No training/evaluation command was run in this review.
limitations: Static files cannot rule out external or earlier execution; proposed qualification is in the review report.
